quests.title: A freestall barn
quests.text: Two rows of stalls, each a bed between dividers, facing a 3-wide alley. A feed bunk with a hay feeder in line with every stall, and a water trough in each row. Cattle eat hay blocks; fill the trough by bucket or pipe. Right-click the controller to form it.

quests.title: Bring in cattle
quests.text: Wild cattle graze the plains and keep their distance. Fence a corral with a post, a one-way gate, a bait trough of hay and a water trough. The hay draws them in through the gate; fed and watered for 7 days, they settle into your herd and the barn takes them. Stay within 64 blocks of the corral post when one settles.

tasks.text: Tame a wild animal in a corral

quests.title: The hatchery
quests.text: An incubator hatches fertile eggs without a broody hen, and a brooder's heat lamp keeps the young birds warm. Both run on low-voltage power, such as the steam turbine's: 25 W and 250 W.

quests.title: Heat lamps for piglets
quests.text: A sow farrows in her crate. Hang a 250 W heat lamp over the creep, on low-voltage power: piglets under it stay warm until weaning, and without one they lose health.

quests.title: The milking parlour
quests.text: Cows walk a lane from the barn once a game day. A vacuum pump and milk line under a row of stalls, a milking unit over each, and a bulk tank whose chiller cools the milk. The pump and the chiller are 480 V three-phase motors.

quests.title: The manure scraper
quests.text: A scraper on a rail down the barn's alley pushes manure into the collection pit once a game day. Its drive at the far end is a 0.75 kW motor on 480 V.

quests.title: The field gantry
quests.text: No tractors: a gantry rides two field rails and carries a tool head across the field to plant, mow, rake, bale or harvest. It trails its cable to a field junction wired to 480 V.

quests.title: Feed mill and mixer
quests.text: A hammer mill grinds grain into meal, and the TMR mixer blends meal, forage and minerals into a balanced ration: more milk, faster growth, more eggs. Both run on 480 V.

quests.title: The creamery
quests.text: A row of parts behind a controller: receiving tank, batch pasteurizer, cream separator, churn, cheese vat and press, aging shelf and bottler. Feed it milk by milk line from the parlour. The pasteurizer's 12 kW heater is three-phase.

quests.title: The digester
quests.text: Manure from the barn goes into the feed pit of a 3 x 3 x 3 digester tank. Its 6.5 kW mixer runs on 480 V. Biogas rises to the gas holder on the roof; digestate goes to the tank at its side.

quests.title: Biogas into a genset
quests.text: Run steel gas pipe from the gas holder to a gas genset. With no natural gas on the line the set burns the farm's biogas, derated to 850 kW. Run it in bursts: the holder empties faster than the digester fills it.

tasks.text: Run a gas genset on the farm's biogas

quests.title: Fertilizer in the spreader
quests.text: Put the spreader head on the gantry and load it with bulk bags of TSP, DAP or MOP from the fertilizer plant. A spread is 10 kg, as a compost item is, so one 1 t bag gives 100 spreads; the gantry opens a new bag only when the last one is spent. The bags work in the spreader only, not by hand.

quests.title: Straws
quests.text: Cut eight straws from a plastic sheet. Fill one from a grown, tame sire, then use it on a female of the same species in heat. Boar straws keep 6 days; turkey straws only 30 minutes.

quests.title: Herd health
quests.text: Animals catch real diseases: mastitis, shipping fever, scours, foot rot and more. A vet kit (leather, glass, iron, string) takes a temperature and names what an animal has; on a barn, shed, coop, pig barn or stable controller it writes a herd check of everything due. Watch for coughing, limping and animals off their feed.

tasks.text: Examine an animal with the vet kit

quests.title: Quarantine and the sick pen
quests.text: An isolation pen keeps new arrivals apart for 30 real days, and sick animals apart from the herd. Pen floor, a feeder and a trough, 8 blocks from any other housing. Sneak and use the controller to switch between quarantine and hospital.

quests.title: Vaccinate
quests.text: Vaccines keep only in the cold room. Give one to the animals it is for: respiratory for cattle, CDT for sheep and goats, erysipelas for pigs, strangles for horses; Marek's goes into the incubator. Boosters fall due a year on.

quests.title: Milk quality
quests.text: Test a cow's milk with the CMT paddle and its reagent, and load teat dip (a glass bottle and a chlorine ton container from the chlor-alkali plant) into the parlor controller: dipping every cow after milking cuts new mastitis by 70%. A waste milk can beside the parlor takes the milk of treated cows.

tasks.text: Load teat dip into a parlor

quests.title: Footbath
quests.text: A footbath in a lane or a gate path, filled with water and charged with 10% zinc sulfate, treats foot rot in every animal that walks through and keeps it off for 14 real days. Zinc sulfate is made from zinc (smelted sphalerite), salt-dome sulfur and water.
